comparison.objective: Advance two lanyard hooks across anchors while maintaining continuous attachment; candidate finishes installed HELICOILs by breaking and recovering tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential hook disengagement and insertion under a safety invariant versus precision mandrel placement, stabilized hammer impact and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Both hooks finish in anchor 3 and at least one remains anchored throughout; candidate requires four fractures and recovered tangs without coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both involve sequential manipulation, but their central tested abilities and failure constraints are meaningfully different.
